ways.label: Makahu Saddle carpark to Mackintosh Track junction

end.name: junction with the track from Lakes carpark to Mackintosh carpark via Mackintosh Hut
end.quote: Lakes carpark to Mackintosh carpark via Mackintosh Hut

evidence: From the Makahu Saddle carpark, a track leads to Ngahere Base (the former hydrological survey base) then follows an old road down to the stream.
Across the bridge, the Matauria Ridge Track turns to the right (the Ngahere Loop Track climbs straight ahead).
It reaches a track junction with the track from Lakes carpark to Mackintosh carpark via Mackintosh Hut.

doubts: No feature for the Makahu Saddle carpark, so the start has no ref. The end is the junction with the linked walk L2 (not far from Mackintosh Hut); L2 refers to that walk, not to the junction point itself. The page gives no time or distance and does not say whether the walk is returned the same way; shape taken as one way from the title 'Makahu Saddle to Mackintosh Track Junction'. The ridge in 'From this wide, open ridge' is taken as Matauria Ridge (T6) from the track name.
